scope: Independent source and future-case/control review; no implementation or runtime proof

reviews.scope: One terminal authority, exact copied identity, per-slot visibility, Pending/error distinctions, completion privacy, retained input/anchor support.

pre_retention_precision_corrections: Pending steps do not clear or advance the raw-return latch; only one actual ReturnedValue advances its sequence.
Snapshot-error case retains actual successful return/tuple before an authored consumed=false substitution; error is explicitly returned, private and terminal.
Bounded model ID alphabet is explicitly [A-Za-z0-9._-], with canonical zero-padded 33-byte storage.
Early and repeated traversal controls use separate fresh scratch; losing-entry delta avoids a false zero-earlier-work claim.
Second-admission hook follows successful CAS only; failed inner CAS cannot recurse.
Binding-index control decoy excludes all tested lookup addresses; expected invariant-error case has a dedicated oracle; diagnostic lookup has a separate trace.
execution_at_review: No retention helper, compiler, source transformer, loader, installer, matrix, native provider, signal, emulator or device execution occurred for this new plan.
limits: All cases and controls are planned, not run.
No new signal, concurrency, native visibility, loader/custody, libc/canary, quiescence or recovery proof.
